title: Right shoulder pain at a diabetes and blood pressure check
source: Adapted from MTS-Dialog (TrainingSet ID 119, GENHX section), CC BY 4.0. Facts are taken only from the source note and dialogue.

profile.context: Attends the clinic alone. No further social details are given in the source record.

facts.text: Has pain in the right shoulder.
Certain movements of the shoulder make it hurt.
There was no injury before the shoulder pain started.
Checks blood sugar only in the mornings; the readings have all been under 100. Does not check after meals.
Home blood pressure readings have been normal when checked, but she has not brought a record of them.
Had a benign breast biopsy in June 2004 and was told to have a repeat mammogram in six months, but never had it.
Came for her five-month diabetes and blood pressure check; has no other concerns.
